subject: POC scope & stakeholder commitments — Atlas Retail evaluation

Subject: POC scope & stakeholder commitments — Atlas Retail evaluation

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion on the evaluation priorities. Per our call, I put together a concise scope and request that we get official owners assigned so we can kick off the POC next week. Please see the proposed success criteria and immediate asks below.

Summary (recommended):
- Goal: Validate Redwood's hosted inference for product recommendations pipeline at 95th percentile latency <= 120ms and embedding throughput of 3k reqs/min with KV cache enabled.
- Duration: 3-week evaluation (setup + run + retrospective).
- Data pattern: batch inference of nightly product catalog + live small-batch queries (50–200 qps spike test).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm / edit):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation < 120ms at target QPS with quantization profile A.
2) Cost: average per-1000 tokens inference cost under $1.20 (hosted pricing baseline).
3) Functional: end-to-end recommendation workflow integration with your staging API (auth + payload).
4) Security: TLS, customer-managed keys optional; no customer data persists beyond session for test runs.

Immediate asks / owners we need on file before kickoff:
- Infra owner (network/firewall/VPN): name + email + target response SLA (we need egress rules + proxy details).
- App owner (integration + test harness): contact for API keys and staging endpoints.
- Procurement / PO contact: for small evaluation purchase if needed.

Suggested kickoff window: Thu Aug 5 or Fri Aug 6 — 30-45 minute tech alignment + walk-through of success criteria.

Attachments: Atlas_POC_success_criteria.xlsx (proposed measurable checks), I also linked the POC plan doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/drive/Atlas-POC-plan

Next steps: please reply to confirm owners and preferred kickoff slot. Once owners are confirmed, we'll send a technical checklist and a short network test script to validate connectivity.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai

Priya — thanks for the clear recap. This looks good overall. A couple of quick edits and confirmations:

- Timeline: Can we do 3 calendar weeks but schedule the run week for the final 7 days so our merchandising team can validate results?
- Success criterion #2 (cost): we need a quick estimate of peak-hour cost at 200 qps to share with finance — can Ben help provide a ballpark?
- Owners: assigning Samir Patel (cc'd) as our infra owner — he'll confirm firewall/NAT details and whether we need a temporary VPN. Joan will be the app owner for the staging API. Procurement contact is Karen Li (karen.li@atlasretail.com) but she'll only be needed if we exceed evaluation credit.

Samir / Joan — can you confirm infra and app owner acceptance and availability for a kickoff on Aug 5 (morning PT preferred)?

Thanks Priya / Alicia. I can take infra ownership for the eval. Quick notes from infra side that will affect kickoff prep:

- Network: outbound egress to our API endpoints will be allowed; we need to whitelist Redwood worker IP ranges (I'll send the list). Egress ports: 443, 853 (dns over tls) — no other ports unless negotiated.
- Proxies: we sit behind an outbound proxy; Redwood will need to support proxy-friendly TLS handshake and keep-alive.
- On-prem: no inbound VPN required for the hosted scenario, but if phase-2 requires private deployment we'll revisit.

I attached our network diagram with the staging VLAN and NAT details. Also confirm Aug 5 morning PT works for a 30-minute kick.

Attachment: network_diagram_v1.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)

Samir Patel
